summary: Complete testing of Resume Builder iteration 27 - Years of Experience onboarding step and 5 distinct templates. All 17 features tested successfully. Frontend-only testing as requested.
passed_tests: Entry page loads with 'Import your resume' (amber) and 'Create my resume' (blue) buttons
Create flow: Entry -> Experience Level -> Years of Experience -> Industry -> Template Selection -> Wizard Editor
Years of Experience screen shows 5 options: Less than 1 year, 1-3 years, 3-5 years, 5-10 years, 10+ years
Years of Experience screen has Back button that navigates to Experience Level page
Years of Experience screen has Continue button (disabled until selection, enabled after selection)
Template Selection page shows 5 distinct template thumbnails (Clean, Professional, Minimal, Executive, Modern)
Clicking different template thumbnails updates the main preview to show the selected template style
Clean template: centered header, thin rules, serif font (data-testid='template-clean')
Professional template: double-rule header border, italic company names (data-testid='template-professional')
Minimal template: left-aligned, lightweight section headers (data-testid='template-minimal')
Executive template: dark header banner, gold accent line, skill pills (data-testid='template-executive')
Modern template: two-column layout with dark sidebar (data-testid='template-modern')
Template Selection shows sample data (Sarah Johnson) when user has no data
'Use this template' button navigates to wizard editor
Wizard editor right panel shows preview using the selected template
Dark sidebar with 7 wizard steps (Header, Experience, Education, Skills, Summary, Additional Details, Finalize)
Import flow works: Entry -> Upload -> Paste -> Processing -> Welcome -> Analysis -> Template Selection -> Wizard
Back buttons navigate to correct previous screens throughout onboarding (Years->Level, Industry->Years)
critical_code_review_comments: TemplateRenderer.tsx: Well-structured with 5 distinct template components (CleanTemplate, ProfessionalTemplate, MinimalTemplate, ExecutiveTemplate, ModernTemplate)
Each template has unique visual characteristics: Clean=serif/centered, Professional=double-border/italic, Minimal=whitespace/left-aligned, Executive=dark-header/gold-accent, Modern=two-column/sidebar
Years of Experience step properly integrated into onboarding flow between Experience Level and Industry
All templates support both 'full' and 'thumb' scale modes for preview and thumbnails
Sample data (Sarah Johnson) correctly displayed when user has no resume data
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
